sn14.20:1.1: samenti || || Cattāri || || Navamaṃ || || Sāvatthi || || Dhātuso bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Anottāpino anottāpīhi saddhim || appassutā appassutehi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhimo || bahussutā bahussutehi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Ekaṃ || || Atītam pi || Anāgatam pi || Etarahi paccuppannam addhānaṃ- samentīti || || Ekaṃ || ||
sn14.20:2.1: Anottāpino anottāpīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || kusītā kusītehi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhiṃ- || āraddhaviriyā āraddhaviriyehi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Atītam pi || Anāgatam pi || Etarahi paccuppannam addhanaṃ || || Dve || ||
sn14.20:3.1: Anottāpino anottāpīhi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || muṭṭhasatino muṭṭhasatīhi saddhiṃ- || || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Ottāpino ottāpīhi saddhimo || upaṭṭhitasatino upaṭṭhitasatīhi saddhiṃ- || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || Atītam
